unsupported: The business was founded by Collin, a welder and fitter with six years of experience across nearly all welding processes.
He established the company to bring specialized welding directly to job sites throughout the region.
Operations are conducted on-site rather than in a fixed facility, with no permanent shop floor disclosed.
Customers come from marine construction, offshore support, industrial maintenance, and residential metalwork.
Typical projects include repairing barge and crew boat structures, fabricating custom rail systems, and restoring heavy equipment components.
The service area covers the Gulf Coast region around Belle Chasse and Gretna.
The mobile model eliminates the need for clients to transport large assemblies, reducing downtime for marine and industrial operators.
